paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
notes: Paper constrains couplings of oscillating UDM to quarks and gluons (QCD sector, dgs, dm-hat, dms) via molecular iodine spectroscopy, frequency range 10 Hz - 10^8 Hz (mass ~4e-14 to 4e-7 eV). Primary exclusion plot (Fig. 3) is on the combination of QCD-sector couplings Q_N·d, which maps to nucleon-mass-type scalar coupling (ScalarNucleon hint is reasonable). Paper also presents bounds on alpha (ScalarPhoton) and m_e (ScalarElectron) in Figs. 4-5, so coupling type is ambiguous among ScalarNucleon/ScalarPhoton/ScalarElectron. No numerical data tables for the exclusion curves are provided in the text; only plots are shown, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs can be extracted. Galactic halo density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed (also solar halo 10^5x and Earth halo scenarios considered). 95% CL bounds. | Vision: This plot shows d_me (ScalarElectron, electron mass variation) on the y-axis, not ScalarNucleon as hinted. The lower boundary traced is the Microscope (cyan) curve which provides the most stringent (lowest) constraint at low masses; it rises steeply and crosses other flat limits (Cu-Pb, Be-Al, etc.) around 1e-11 eV. At higher masses the lowest envelope follows the rising Be-type/Microscope sloped lines. Y-axis multiplier reflects axis ticks given. Coupling type uncertain - plot is d_me but paper abstract emphasizes quark/gluon couplings. | Calibration: No calibration needed
